All 9 tests pass. Nothing else was needed after the test run, and I did not commit since you didn't ask for that. Changes, all in `reports/render.py`: - **Added `"csv"` renderer.** Header row of column names, then one comma-joined line per row, no title. - **Added `"html"` renderer.** Emits the `

` title, ``, a `` of `` of `
` cells, one `
` cells per row, and `
`, each on its own line. Both use the existing `@format_renderer` registry, so `available_formats()` picks them up automatically. - **Added `render_many(reports, fmt)`.** Returns a list built by calling `render` on each report. - **Dropped the trailing newline from rendered output.** The new batch test pins the text output to `"B\n\n1"` and requires it to equal what `render` returns, so the shared join helper no longer appends a final newline. The existing tests all compare via `splitlines()` and are unaffected. - **Adjusted the text renderer for empty rows.** With no trailing newline, the old line-list approach lost the blank separator line when there were no rows, which broke an existing test. The text renderer now emits the title and blank line as a header block and joins the rows after it, so both the empty-rows and batch cases hold.
